answer: Scarce-slot namespace with rotating plumes: each agent identity must own a unique namespace slot, and slots rotate. To claim a slot, an agent submits a signed plume (a random challenge token derived from recent global entropy) proving it solved a memory-hard puzzle bound to that slot. Slots are limited per grove (a shard of 10,000 agents), and joining a grove requires presenting a bridge token from a prior grove you already participated in.
